subject: Money
title: Anchoring
description: A micro-lesson that makes Anchoring usable.

hook.text: A jacket marked $500, now $250. Great deal? You don't know. But the $500 anchor made you think so.

buildup.text: Anchoring means the first number you see shapes all future judgments. It's automatic and unconscious.

discovery.text: Real estate agents show an overpriced house first. Everything after seems reasonable by comparison.

twist.text: Even random numbers anchor. Studies show spinning a wheel affects how much people bid at auction.

climax.text: Every 'original price' is an anchor. Every 'was $X, now $Y' exploits your brain's laziness.

quiz.question: What is anchoring in pricing psychology?
options: Using the first number to shape judgment
